title: Undo finishes after a failed or lost undo write, and an unreachable site is LIVE_UNREACHABLE
steps: Undo with a 503 on the first undo write, then Undo again.
Undo with an undo write that lands but loses its answer and a later read refused, then Undo again.
Undo with the live site down.
expect: First Undo answers WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN having restored the rest; the second ends undone with both restored, three undo writes in all.
The second Undo ends undone, nothing kept, post 2 not written again.

tests: an Undo write a proxy answered 503
an Undo write that landed with its answer lost
an Undo that cannot reach the live site says LIVE_UNREACHABLE
